acceptance_gates.gate2: PASS (real two-host NCCL process group + collectives)
acceptance_gates.hardware_evidence: T058-T060 + T062-T064 real two-host execution records under /var/tmp/shardgrid/engines/ and /var/tmp/shardgrid/distributed/reports/

decision: Galvatron v2.4.0 is the selected MVP parallel engine, used with explicit parallel configuration (one stage per physical host, small stage budgets) as proven by T058/T059/T060 and Gate 1/Gate 2. PyTorch's mature torch.distributed.pipelining is a supported fallback candidate (T063). DeepSpeed Pipeline (T062) and nnScaler (T064) are blocked/not-selected on this environment. The static validation path (explicit plans, no profiler-driven search) is labeled limited MVP support. ShardGrid does NOT reimplement autograd, collectives, CUDA kernels/allocators, or a full pipeline framework: all are delegated to PyTorch, NCCL/Gloo, and the selected engine's documented APIs.

engines.evidence: T058 one-GPU-per-host placement true_multi_host; T059 heterogeneous accepted; T060 pipeline/runtime/checkpoint/model-profiler pass; Gate1/Gate2 pass; examples/compatibility/galvatron-report.json (experimental, accepted for MVP with explicit parallel configuration)
limitations: search engine blocked (depends on hardware profiler)
static/explicit parallel configs labeled limited support
